concerns.text: Task T008 specifies building a control‑flow graph from a PR diff (plain‑text) using `networkx` and the AST. Constructing an AST directly from a diff is not feasible without reconstructing the full source files, making the task unexecutable as written. The deliverable should either fetch the full source code for each PR or redefine the complexity metric to operate on available data (e.g., using added/removed lines).
